about_the_game:
Future War Tactics: SOF vs Alien Invasion – Turn-Based Strategy is a single-player turn-based strategy game where you lead a Special Operations Forces (SOF) unit in a fight against a mysterious alien threat.

MYSTERIOUS DISAPPEARANCES AND ANOMALIES

The events unfold in the near future. In the Ural Federal District, mass disappearances of people are occurring, accompanied by geomagnetic disturbances and strange atmospheric phenomena.

YOU ARE THE SOF COMMANDER

You are assigned to investigate the incident sites and uncover the reasons behind what’s happening. But the mission takes a darker turn when unknown creatures launch an attack on your squad.

WHO ARE THESE CREATURES?

As you progress, you’ll have to uncover who these aliens are, where they came from, why they are abducting people and stealing weapons — and how to fight them.

TACTICAL COMBAT AND STRATEGY

Use different combinations of weapons and abilities, build your tactics — every decision you make can impact not just the mission, but the fate of all humanity.

Take command, uncover the truth, and fight back against the invaders. The future is in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8, Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
